items.prompt: Complete the table about two 3D shapes.
head: Shape
Faces
Edges
Vertices
hints: Think of a dice for the cube.
A cube has 4 edges on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 going up.
A square pyramid has a square base and 4 triangle faces.
items.explanation: A cube has 12 edges. A square pyramid has 1 square face and 4 triangle faces, which makes 5 faces.
